The pre-registration is written and hash-frozen by one task and committed before any measuring task exists, so the ordering is externally notarized rather than self-reported.
coordinator_verified: The Coordinator independently recomputed sha256(prereg.md) with shasum -a 256 and with python hashlib; both agree and match the producer's prereg_sha256.txt exactly. The Coordinator additionally re-derived the Section B operating characteristic from scratch: t_{7,0.998} = 4.2071245566046755, union bound 48 x 0.002 = 0.096 <= 0.10, and the reported Sidak reference 1 - 0.998^48 = 0.0916233087376801 -- all three reproduce exactly. no_measurement_performed: The producer reports, and its deliverables corroborate, that no lattice was generated or reduced, no basis built, no frame computed, no draw sampled, and no V, E_I, D, quantile or arm statistic evaluated. The only computation was Student-t tail quantiles and elementary projector/Beta algebra in (d, k, beta, N, n) -- the analytic derivation AM-3 requires -- plus a read of committed numbers. The execution report's runs.completed list is empty.
